topic.title: Saxon XSLT and XQuery Transformer Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Saxon XSLT and XQuery Transformer add-on installs an external Saxon processor so you can validate and transform XSLT and XQuery documents.

keywords.indexterm: Saxon XSLT and XQuery transformer add-on

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
body.p: offers an add-on that installs an external Saxon XSLT and XQuery processor and allows you to validate and transform XSLT and XQuery documents with that external processor. The default add-on update site includes versions for Saxon 9.6, 9.7, 9.8, 9.9, 10.7, 10.9, 11.6, 12.10, and 13.0.
